name: cpu_m3v
display_name: Magpie M3V — hybrid NPU line (frozen M1A scalar host + net-new tightly-coupled int8/int4 GEMV TCU + TCM/DMA), forked from M1A

commercial.note: maturity stays 'draft' until the SKU-1 MVP exit bar is met (DV bar-B-minus + code/functional coverage closure + integrator docs + non-author handoff test). Do not bump on gate count alone (ADR-0012 honesty guardrail).

sku1_mvp.irq_scope: external-MEI-only (irq_external_pulse); MTI/MSI/async OUT OF SCOPE, documented not waived
sku1_mvp.dv_bar: bar-B-minus = riscv-dv full-mix EXCLUDING async interrupts; Spike per-commit lockstep
sku1_mvp.coverage_bar: functional 100% on scope (incl fence.i + MEI) AND code line/toggle >=85% or ADR waiver
sku1_mvp.ppa: DC trial = indicative, not production signoff
sku1_mvp.isa_note: isa = current RTL truth; the Zb*/Zicond string is the ADR-0026 Phase A2 TARGET, claimable only after A2 gates green (honest taxonomy: planned != present)

provenance_fork.sibling: Magpie_M1V (cpu_m1v) — CoralNPU IMPORT route (ADR-0030); M3V is the independent self-built HYBRID route, evidence hard-isolated from M1V
provenance_fork.note: Full-history clone of M1A at its RTL-freeze tag. M1A/M1 Tier-2 evidence is NOT claimable by cpu_m3v; all gates/coverage/lockstep must be re-earned on this line (the inherited M1A scalar+TCM RTL under design/cpu_m1/ stays FROZEN as host and is re-verified only as a no-regression guard). All net-new ML work lands under design/npu/. Physical path design/cpu_m1/ retained to avoid Makefile/gate churn; identity = design_id cpu_m3v everywhere.
provenance_fork.scope: docs/adr/0031-m3v-hybrid-npu-scope.md (self-built tightly-coupled GEMV; NOT CoralNPU import)
